templates.name: Semantic map
templates.cypher:
MATCH (d:Domain)-[c:CONTAINS]->(s:Subject)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[l:LINKED]-(s2:Subject)
RETURN d, c, s, l, s2

templates.name: Table
templates.cypher:
MATCH (t:Table {name: $name})
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[j:JOINS]-(o:Table)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[d:DERIVED_FROM]->(src:Table)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[i:IN_SUBJECT]->(s:Subject)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[u:USE_INSTEAD]->(alt:Table)
RETURN t, j, o, d, src, i, s, u, alt

templates.name: Join
templates.cypher:
MATCH (a:Table {name: $a}), (b:Table {name: $b})
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:JOINS*..6]-(b))
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE NOT r.suspect)
RETURN p

templates.name: Who uses
templates.cypher:
MATCH (t:Table {name: $name})<-[c:CONSUMES]-(p:Principal)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[m:MEMBER_OF]->(tm:Team)
RETURN t, c, p, m, tm

templates.name: Traps
templates.cypher:
MATCH (t:Avoid)
WHERE coalesce(t.consumer_count, 0) > 0
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[u:USE_INSTEAD]->(alt:Table)
RETURN t, u, alt

templates.name: Variable
templates.cypher:
MATCH (v:Variable {display_name: $v})<-[i:IS]-(c:Column)<-[h:HAS_COLUMN]-(t:Table)
RETURN v, i, c, h, t

templates.name: Customer identity
templates.cypher:
MATCH (e:Entity)<-[i:IDENTIFIES]-(v:Variable)
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[l:LINKED_VIA]-(v2:Variable)
RETURN e, i, v, l, v2

templates.name: Sensitive data
templates.cypher:
MATCH (t:Table)-[h:HAS_COLUMN]->(c:Column) WHERE c.sensitive AND t.in_catalog
MATCH (t)-[d:IN_DATASET]->(ds:Dataset)
OPTIONAL MATCH (f:Finding)-[a:ABOUT]->(c)
RETURN t, h, c, d, ds, f, a

templates.name: Suspect joins
templates.cypher:
MATCH (f:Finding {kind: 'suspect_join'})-[a:ABOUT]->(c:Column)<-[h:HAS_COLUMN]-(t:Table)
RETURN f, a, c, h, t

templates.name: Findings about
templates.cypher:
MATCH (t:Table {name: $name})
OPTIONAL MATCH (f:Finding)-[a:ABOUT]->(t)
OPTIONAL MATCH (g:Finding)-[b:ABOUT]->(c:Column)<-[h:HAS_COLUMN]-(t)
RETURN t, f, a, g, b, c, h
